projects.name: Project concept | Phase Zero is a Cloud 2.0 company providing SaaS based B2B E-Commerce platform (called Aftermarket) for commercial partners selling products such as Automotive Parts including Industrial Supplies.
details: Responsibilities | Analysing Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and translated them into functional specifications and technical solutions.
Collaborating with the product team on sprint planning, backlog grooming, and user story refinement.
Designed and implemented application structures based on user stories in a multi-tenant environment.
Developed and maintained RESTful APIs, ensuring scalability and integration across multiple tenants.
Led the Professional Services team, delivering custom client requirements with high quality and within deadlines.
Acted as Customer Support Lead, managing and resolving P1/P2 issues, ensuring timely delivery and issue resolution.
Integrated various third-party systems, including :ERP APIs (e.g., Karmak, Infor) ,Payment gateways (e.g., CardPointe, PayPal)
Procurement platforms (e.g., Coupa) with eCommerce systems
